sections.heading: Lusha at a glance
sections.body: Lusha is the B2B data and intelligence layer used by 1M+ GTM teams globally. With AI-powered lead suggestions Lusha also integrates with Claude, n8n, Make, Clay, Hubspot, Salesforce and more.

sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under Development, Lusha is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 13 category signals and 5 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask Lusha for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
sections.body: The strongest signal in this assessment is audience fit; the area requiring the most buyer diligence is product clarity. These signals describe documentation quality and should not be read as measured product performance.

faq.question: How is the Lusha score calculated?
